description: Returns a short sourced brief on one company as {company, summary, what_it_does, facts, recent, sources}, usually in 5 to 8 seconds. Pass a website address such as stripe.com to avoid name clashes; a bare name resolves to the best-known company with that name and the summary says when the name is ambiguous. Facts such as founding year, location, size, funding or leadership appear only when the sources state them, and conflicting figures are reported as the most recent one with its date. Read-only. Paid per call with x402; if the company cannot be described in time the call fails and is not charged.

company.description: A company name or website, 1 to 500 characters, e.g. Stripe or stripe.com.
company.title: Company

name: research.company

facts.description: Up to 5 short facts, only if the sources state them.
